instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Event venue and catering company managing a conference center and 3 satellite event spaces. Hosting 500+ corporate events and weddings annually. Looking to implement end-to-end event management software covering CRM, floor plan design, menu customization, and day-of operations coordination. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base — our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-8 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 6 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 15%.

opportunities.title: Strategic Market Expansion and Diversification
opportunities.rationale: The dependency on the top 3 clients (55% of revenue) poses an unacceptable concentration risk. This opportunity must continue to develop new, stable revenue streams by identifying adjacent market segments or entirely new business models that leverage existing venue assets.

first_actions: Conduct a portfolio analysis mapping current core capabilities against 3-5 underserved, non-core customer segments.
Run structured workshops with sales and executive leadership to define minimum viable product (MVP) offerings for these new segments.
Establish clear Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) focused purely on revenue diversification targets over the next 18 months.
resources_needed: External industry consultants specializing in B2B service models.
Dedicated time from executive leadership (minimum 5 hours/week).
execution_plan.success_metric: Percentage reduction of revenue concentration risk below 40% within 2 years.
milestones: Identification and validation of two new target market segments.
Pilot launch of one diversified product line (MVP) within a low-risk segment.
Formal integration of diversification goals into annual budget planning.

opportunities.title: End-to-End Event Management Platform Implementation
opportunities.rationale: The current ad-hoc use of disparate digital tools creates operational friction and limits scalability. Implementing a unified platform covering CRM, floor plans, menu management, and day-of coordination is critical for moving beyond foundational systems into optimized processes.

first_actions: Define detailed functional requirements (Scope Definition) across all departments (Sales, Operations, Finance).
Vendor evaluation and selection process, prioritizing system compatibility and demonstrable compliance adherence.
Pilot integration with the existing successful CRM system to minimize disruption.
resources_needed: Dedicated IT/Tech team resource (ring-fenced capacity for 6 months).
Cross-functional Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) from Operations and Sales.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in manual data transfer touchpoints by 70% post-implementation; measurable decrease in event setup time.
milestones: Finalized platform selection and Statement of Work (SOW) signed.
Successful UAT (User Acceptance Testing) cycle completion for core workflows.
Full operational rollout across all satellite locations.

next_steps.action: Formalize and protect dedicated, ring-fenced time/budget for innovation efforts (e.g., 20% of the tech team's capacity).
Establish a Governance Committee comprised of key stakeholders to prioritize new system integrations and minimize ad-hoc solution development.
Develop a structured roadmap for the diversification opportunity, starting with deep customer needs analysis in non-core segments.

key_weaknesses: Operational Resource Overload: The small technology team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling urgent client requests, leaving little bandwidth for strategic innovation.
Formal Process Gaps: While successful deployments show capability, formal governance structures needed to scale complex systems (like the end-to-end platform) are still underdeveloped.
Strategic Myopia: Continued high dependence on a single product category and limited customer base prevents long-term resilience.

improvements: Successful deployment of CRM system improved lead tracking and reduced data entry time by 30%.
Implementation of dedicated customer feedback channels has provided structured research input for process improvements.
Innovation budget commitment increased by 15%, providing more financial oxygen.
persistent_gaps: The lack of formal innovation prioritization and resource ring-fencing remains a critical bottleneck to scalability.
Integration efforts are still ad-hoc, pointing to systemic weaknesses rather than isolated tool gaps.
Leadership attention is highly focused on immediate maintenance needs, delaying strategic architectural decisions.
achieved_milestones: CRM system successfully adopted by the sales team.
Pilot customer feedback mechanism operationalized across event spaces.
Demonstrated ability to execute complex software implementations with dedicated project management.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has progressed from basic system adoption to actively managing process improvements (CRM success) and generating structured data (customer feedback). The primary shift is moving from 'awareness' to 'execution capability,' but structural governance still lags behind rapid operational growth.
